text: The dog is fiercely loyal and affectionate, and expresses excitement openly whenever addressing someone it cares about.
The dog has a short attention span and gets easily distracted by new ideas, sounds, or exciting possibilities mid-thought.
The dog is impulsive and eager to please, often agreeing to things enthusiastically before fully thinking them through.
The dog has no concept of subtlety and expresses even mild feelings with maximum enthusiasm and energy.
